data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri eyes Haggerty vs Yod-IQ clash and bantamweight Grand Prix
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty could return to Muay Thai against Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri in 2027, with ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong also considering a bantamweight World Grand Prix.

data.title: Trial of MLB players on pitch-rigging scandal opens
data.description: NEW YORK — The trial of two Major League Baseball (MLB) players accused of rigging pitches in a gambling scheme got under way in New York on Monday with jury selection.

data.title: The German Makkabi sports club where Muslims outnumber Jews
data.description: FRANKFURT — When they sweat it out at a big German sports club, Jewish, Muslim and other athletes are also sending a strong signal against rising antisemitism, the head of Makkabi Frankfurt told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: Rising star Aeya's life cut short
data.description: The Thai golf community is mourning the loss of 15-year-old junior golfer Aeyavarin "Aeya" Pradubyart, who passed away following a lightning strike during a junior golf tournament in Chachoengsao on Sunday.

data.title: T1 giants Ratchaburi and Port seek Asian lifelines
data.description: Ratchaburi hope to salvage a point against Vissel Kobe in the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday.

data.title: Thai juniors rule world meet at Hua Hin
data.description: Thailand's young golfers claimed several titles at the Singha Thailand Junior World Golf Championship, which concluded at Royal Hua Hin Golf Course in Prachuap Khiri Khan on Sunday.

data.title: ONE Championship: Tawanchai could return in April, Superlek may need nine more months
data.description: Tawanchai PK Saenchai could return to the ring around April 2027, while Superlek Kiatmoo9 may need another nine months to recover from knee surgery, according to ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty knee ruled legal in unanimous 12–0 review, source says
data.description: An independent review has unanimously ruled Jonathan Haggerty’s disputed knee against Hiroki Akimoto legal, the Bangkok Post understands, leaving his ONE Championship bantamweight kickboxing title victory intact.

data.title: First point for Dragons, Port slump again
data.description: Ratchaburi claimed their first point of the AFC Champions League Elite on Tuesday night, holding Japan’s Kashiwa Reysol to a goalless draw, but Port slipped to a third straight defeat with a 3-0 loss at Johor Darul Ta’zim.

data.title: Big payday! Thailand’s heroes pocket Bt123m in rewards
data.description: Thailand’s Asian Para Games athletes enjoyed a big payday as they bagged over 123 million baht in cash rewards following their excellent performance at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 in Japan this month.

data.title: 'Grateful' Antonelli becomes youngest Formula One world champion
data.description: MEXICO CITY — Kimi Antonelli became Formula One's youngest world champion and Italy's first since 1953 when he finished third behind multiple champions Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton in Sunday's thrilling and crash-hit Mexico City Grand Prix.

data.title: Arsenal ride out Liverpool storm to top Premier League
data.description: LIVERPOOL — Arsenal moved to the top of the Premier League with their first win away to Liverpool in 14 years as Kai Havertz's early strike secured a 1-0 victory for the Gunners.

data.title: Chinese state TV fails to air Real Madrid match after Mbappe row
data.description: BEIJING — Chinese state broadcaster China Central Television ( CCTV ) did not broadcast a Real Madrid La Liga match on Sunday after star forward Kylian Mbappe caused a furore in China with remarks he made about former leader Mao Zedong.

data.title: Omitted events spark anger
data.description: Southeast Asia's cyclists face being short-changed at next year's SEA Games after hosts Malaysia stripped mountain biking and BMX to the bone, provoking a regional protest and a vow from Thailand to force a rethink.

data.title: Antonelli becomes youngest Formula One world champion
data.description: MEXICO CITY - Kimi Antonelli drove the perfect race to finish third in his Mercedes at the Mexico Grand Prix and seal his place in Formula One history as the youngest world champion.

data.title: Home victory give Pattani some respite
data.description: Pattani edged Rasisalai United 2-1 in the Thai League 1 at Tinsulanonda Stadium on Saturday night, moving into 13th place on seven points.

data.title: Fifa earns Open and Masters tickets with Asia-Pacific win
data.description: Pongsapak "Fifa" Laopakdee successfully defended his Asia-Pacific Amateur Championship title, winning the 2026 edition at Te Arai Links' South Course in New Zealand yesterday.

data.title: Yamaha pulls out of Qatar MotoGP over 'Middle East situation'
data.description: SEPANG (MALAYSIA) - Yamaha said on Sunday it will not participate in next weekend's Qatar MotoGP, citing "the situation in the Middle East".

data.description: The 34th Southeast Asian (SEA) Games, to be hosted by Malaysia next year, will feature 473 gold medal events across 43 sports, including padel, which will make its debut in the regional tournament.

data.title: Thunder Castle and Silva part ways after 10 games
data.description: Buriram United have parted company with Portuguese coach Mario Silva after just two months, with the Thai League 1 champions changing head coach for the second time this season.

data.title: Brighton stun Man City, 10-man Man Utd beaten by Chelsea
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Brighton inflicted a second straight Premier League defeat on Manchester City with a 1-0 win to close within two points of the leaders on Saturday, while Manchester United slumped to another damaging defeat for Michael Carrick at Chelsea.

data.title: Hudson's King's Cup plans hit by club snub
data.description: National football team head coach Anthony Hudson is forced to rethink his plans after several Thai League 1 clubs refused to release their players for next month's King's Cup tournament, which will take place in Sri Sa Ket province from Nov 14-17.

data.title: Cod Army revel, Kane joins the royalty
data.description: The fundamental appeal of Cup competitions in football is that every now and again there is a major upset. And that is exactly what happened in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday night when League Two strugglers Fleetwood Town beat Premier League defending champions Arsenal 5-3 on penalties after the score was 1-1 in regular time.

data.title: First-half blitz in HK earns Rabbits their first victory
data.description: BG Pathum United claimed their first win of their AFC Champions League Two campaign when they defeated Tai Po 3-0 at Mong Kok Stadium in Hong Kong on Thursday night.

data.title: Puripol proud as NOCT honours sprinter
data.description: Sprinter Puripol Boonson expressed his deep sense of pride after he was honoured by the National Olympic Committee of Thailand (NOCT) during a special ceremony on Thursday.

data.title: Buriram left waiting for first ACL Elite win
data.description: Thai League 1 champions Buriram United were kept waiting for their first win in the AFC Champions League Elite after a 1-1 draw at Japan’s Gamba Osaka on Wednesday night.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri defends Haggerty over Akimoto knee – ‘There was no foul’
data.description: ONE Championship boss Chatri Sityodtong has defended Jonathan Haggerty’s disputed knee against Hiroki Akimoto, citing slow-motion footage to reject claims of an illegal strike.
